title: BedrockCrafter
description: This pack makes bedrock craftable and adds an enchantment to break it in survival.
body:
![Minecraft title text. The top is bedrock, saying craft bedrock. The bottom is blue, saying abyssal vanguard.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/934e0ede087e4308f0564521eb2c4678ed886fa6.png)
## Craft Bedrock
This datapack adds a crafting recipe for bedrock to the game. You're able to craft 8 pieces using dragon's breath, obsidian, deepslate, and stone. It also adds an enchantment which allows you to break bedrock, at the cost of a chunk of your pickaxe's durability.

### Why This Matters
Unlock More Decoration: You can use bedrock for a huge range of things, including decoration. It's a perfect addition to an end or nether build and fits well in a gradient.
Easy Nether Roof Access: The new enchantment makes it much easier to make an opening to the nether roof. Feel free to connect your portals without having to make complicated block breakers!
Multiplayer-Safe: The pack is lightweight and perfect for use in an SMP with your friends. Have fun making impenetrable defenses!

### Compatibility
Works with 1.21 and newer
Compatible with most datapacks and mods

This pack is perfect if you like to incorporate unobtainable blocks in a balanced way.

Made by MeowingChip5
